entities.name: Jonathan Dasnières de Veigy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jonathan Dasnières de Veigy is a former French professional tennis player. Dasnières de Veigy competes mainly on the ATP Challenger Tour, both in singles and doubles. He reached his highest ATP singles ranking, No. 146, on 25 February 2013, and his highest ATP doubles ranking, No. 337, on 12 August 2012.
